title: The Innocents Abroad
author: Mark Twain
description: Twain on a package cruise to Europe and the Holy Land, being rude about all of it. The bestselling book of his lifetime, and the first travel comedy.
snippet: For months the great pleasure excursion to Europe and the Holy Land was chatted about in the newspapers everywhere in America and discussed…
